title: Inter don't need a €40m center back — Bastoni scored again
caption: Inter don't need a €40m center back. Bastoni scored again for Italy in Paris, per Inter.it — his second goal in two games. Corriere dello Sport says Inter are watching Finn Jeltsch, 20, of Stuttgart, valued at €40m. #Inter #InterParma #Bastoni https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=32
